store.0: User Michael, 35, from Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics. Ordered a stainless-steel espresso machine with steam wand; delivery delayed, tracking status stuck, no updates in over a week. Family gathering approaching; anxious about missing the delivery.
